answers.input: Can I use my contactless JCB card at Shanghai metro gates? I have not told you my credit limit.

answer.text:
Yes — JCB brand-level support for direct contactless gate tapping on Shanghai Metro is published. Shanghai extended bank-card tap-to-ride to the rail network (including suburban lines) from June 28, 2025, and JCB's June 30, 2025 announcement confirms contactless-card payment at subway gates or designated readers in Shanghai and Beijing, including airport routes, without buying a ticket first.

Conditions to check on your own card:
- It must be an eligible JCB contactless chip card usable in China; Type-B chips and cards without ODA are excluded.
- Small-amount PIN-free payment must be enabled, and sufficient balance or available credit is needed.
- No separate metro activation is required.

Your not stating a credit limit does not mean JCB is unsupported — brand acceptance and whether one specific card will transact are two different questions. If entry fails, you can switch to a transit code; if exit fails after entering, go to the station service center.

Note this is direct gate tapping, not the same as buying a ticket first or binding the card in an app. These are saved summaries, not live verification; network counts in the announcements are historical, and not every JCB card or mobile wallet is guaranteed to work.

services.description: Use Metro Daduhui or supported Alipay/WeChat transit services. Buy single-journey tickets at stations; they are valid on the purchase day and do not cover out-of-station transfers. Confirm distance-based fares with the operator.

answers.input: 想了解上海的浦东和虹桥机场有哪些真实航线资料，不用模拟票价。

answer.text:
关于浦东（PVG）和虹桥（SHA）的真实航线资料，目前保存的摘要里只有一份历史航季记录可用：机场集团记录的2025年3月30日至10月25日夏秋航季，浦东日均计划航班1694架次、虹桥784架次，计划加密至武汉、福州、厦门、成都等国内航线。这是当时的机场与航线规划记录，不能证明今天的班次、航站楼、票价或余位，也不构成完整航线清单。

其余已保存摘要涉及机场联络线（2024年12月26日开通公告：虹桥2号航站楼站至浦东1号2号航站楼站，票价26元、约40分钟，初期两端首班06:00、末班22:00，属市域线而非航班）、浦东与虹桥的官方出租车上车点、浦东T1/T2过夜休息区充电设施、浦东到达区服务，以及上海虹桥站（国铁）和沪杭高铁浮动票价，均不含具体航线明细。

因此，具体航线、航司与航班号需要以机场或航司的当天查询为准；保存摘要未提供实时航线表，我无法据此列出真实航线清单。若你告诉我关注的具体城市对（例如上海至某地）或想按国内/国际区分，我可以帮你梳理需要核对的信息项。
